briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate AGI race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier is accelerating with new model releases from OpenAI and Anthropic pushing capabilities boundaries. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally. Multi-agent systems are emerging as the next battleground for security and performance.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning while Anthropic's Claude 4.1 shows gains in long-context tasks. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 and DeepSeek unveiled R2. xAI's Grok-3 benchmarks suggest competitive multimodal performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-teaming reports highlight risks in agentic workflows while EU AI Act enforcement begins.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly as Microsoft and Google expand data centers. TSMC reports AI chip demand surging 70% YoY. Energy constraints slow new builds in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for autonomous systems by 2028?
